findings.detail: The log line explaining the `Not on venue page` sheet is a 150-char string literal in the component, while the sheet's own wording lives in `BOOKING_ONLY_NOTE` (`utils/freshaVenue.ts:32`). The two describe the same fact and must stay in agreement, but only one has a single source. This branch already corrected exactly this shape for the fields message (commit f1e1e07, "one source for the fields message") and for the summary line (659120c, `freshaSummary` extracted as a pure helper) — this literal is the last one left. `e2e/web-scraper-fresha.spec.ts:97` asserts on a regex substring of it rather than importing it, so a reword in the component that drifts from the sheet's wording would still pass if the regex fragment survives.
findings.summary: Booking-only warning is an inline literal while its sheet text is a shared constant

findings.detail: `parts[0]` is built with unconditional plurals, so a one-category/one-service venue logs `1 services in 1 categories`. This is user-visible text in the log panel, not an internal diagnostic — `e2e/web-scraper-fresha.spec.ts:159` and `tests/unit/freshaVenue.test.ts:405` both currently pin the ungrammatical wording, so it is locked in rather than accidental. Low because it is cosmetic and the realistic venue has many services; it would not rise above low unless the log were also the error-path message a user has to act on.
findings.summary: freshaSummary emits "1 services in 1 categories" for single-item venues
